description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 1+1 ne zonen e ish-fusha aviacionit me akses te lehte ne rrugen dritan hoxha.
Pallati ku ndodhet apartamenti eshte me standarte ndertimi bashke-kohore dhe fasade te ventiluar.
Ky apartament eshte nje mundesi e mire investimi ose per te banuar.
description_en: We offer a 1+1 apartment in the area of ​​the former aviation field with easy access to Dritan Hoxha street. The building where the apartment is located has contemporary construction standards and a ventilated facade. This apartment is a good investment opportunity or to live.
